extracted.intended_audience: advanced undergraduates or beginning graduate students in mathematics (complex analysis, modular forms, elliptic curves)
extracted.subtask_description: Expository textbook/lecture notes introducing group actions, complex analysis preliminaries, modular forms of level 1, Eisenstein series, the Weierstrass ℘-function, and their relation to elliptic curves. Intended to develop the background needed to link elliptic curves and modular forms.
